questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

I cannot see without my __glasses__.

options.text: A device used to correct the defects of vision

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "A device used to correct the defects of vision".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"glasses"** refers to an optical device consisting of lenses mounted in a frame that rests on the nose and ears, used to correct or enhance vision. (चश्मा)

 
 
• **Example:** She put on her glasses to read the fine print in the book.
 
 
 
• The correct word in this context is **"glasses"**, which is a device used to help people with defective vision see clearly. (चश्मा)
 
 
• **Example:** Without my glasses, everything looks blurry to me.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: A container** (डिब्बा): An object used to hold or store things.

 
 
• **Example:** The kitchen was full of containers holding different spices.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A fragile object** (नाज़ुक वस्तु): Something that is delicate and can be easily broken.
 
 
• **Example:** Handle the glass vase carefully as it is fragile.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: An unbreakable object** (अटूट वस्तु): An object that is resistant to breaking.
 
 
• **Example:** This bottle is made of unbreakable plastic.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

During the _____ of Queen Victoria, England made all-round progress.
questions.solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**reign**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**reign**" refers to the period during which a sovereign rules. (शासनकाल)
 
• Queen Victoria's reign marked a period of significant progress and prosperity in England.
 
• The other options, such as "**rain**" (precipitation), "**rein**" (a strap to guide a horse), and "**rhine**" (a river), do not fit the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *During the reign__ of Queen Victoria, England made all-round progress.*

• **Rain (बारिश)**: Refers to water droplets falling from clouds.
 
• **Rein (लगाम)**: Refers to the leather strap used to control a horse.
 
• **Rhine (राइन)**: Refers to a major European river.
```

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

The __board__ will look into the matter.

options.text: A group of members of a company

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "A group of members of a company".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"board"** refers to a group of individuals who manage or oversee the operations and decision-making of a company, organization, or institution. (परिषद, प्रबंधन मंडल)

 
 
• **Example:** The board decided to increase the company’s investment in renewable energy projects.
 
 
 
• The correct meaning of the word "board" in the given context is a "group of members of a company" (कंपनी के सदस्यों का समूह). This refers to the governing body that looks into and makes decisions about important matters related to the organization.
 
 
• **Example:** The board of directors approved the annual budget for the next fiscal year.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of "board" in this context matches Option 3.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A union of workers** (मज़दूर संघ): A group of employees who come together to advocate for their rights and interests in the workplace.

 
 
• **Example:** The union of workers organized a strike to demand better wages.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A member of a family** (परिवार का सदस्य): An individual belonging to a family unit.
 
 
• **Example:** Every member of the family contributed to the preparation for the festival.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: A group of elected politicians** (चुने हुए राजनेताओं का समूह): Refers to a governing or legislative body made up of elected officials.
 
 
• **Example:** The group of elected politicians discussed the new policy reforms in the parliament.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Pros and cons
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Arguments for and against something**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**pros and cons**" refers to the arguments or factors in favour of and against a particular decision, action, or situation.
 
• It represents a balanced evaluation of the advantages (pros) and disadvantages (cons) associated with something.
 
• When discussing the pros and cons of an issue, people consider both the positive and negative aspects to make an informed decision or form an opinion.
 
 
• **For example**, in a debate about implementing a new policy, participants might discuss the pros and cons to weigh the benefits and drawbacks before reaching a conclusion.
 
 

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.
